teaser: A ledger balanced twice before anyone else is awake. A room that turns to watch you before you've decided to be watched. You are a life path 8, the number built for command and capital, wearing the four letters of ESFP, the type built for presence and the pull of an audience. Most 8s climb through spreadsheets and quiet leverage. You climb through a handshake that lands, a joke timed right, a room that trusts you before the numbers are even on the table. The particular thing here is an ambition that moves through charm instead of around it, power built in full view rather than behind a door.
